headline: Excluded: NewBloom Cafe operating for 1 year (below 2-year requirement) with 58/95 points scored.
whyThisRank: NewBloom Cafe is ranked 12th because it is excluded on eligibility for operating for only 1 year, placing it behind applicants like Sparse Workshop despite scoring 58 points.
justification: NewBloom Cafe scored 58 out of 95 points under the investment readiness track, securing full points for 100% women ownership, female employee share, green sector impact, and management team capacity. However, the application is formally excluded because the company has operated for only 1 year, failing the requirement of more than 2 years. Furthermore, a data contradiction exists where 2024 trading history is reported despite the 1-year operation timeline, and sales growth remains unestablished due to missing 2023 sales data. The company also scored zero points on job creation potential under criterion 7b.
strengths: Achieved maximum points for 100% women ownership and 66.7% female staffing (Criteria 5.1 and 5.2)
Full points awarded for expected intervention results, green sector impact, and management capacity (Criteria 6, 8, and 9)
Reaches international or export destinations in market served (Criterion 3)
watchouts: Excluded due to failing the minimum 2-year operational history requirement (Check AGE_OVER_2Y)
Contradiction identified between 1-year operating timeline and reported 2024 sales and staffing figures
Sales growth (Criterion 1.1) is unestablished due to missing 2023 financial figures
Zero points scored for job creation potential under investment readiness (Criterion 7b)
Low product uniqueness rating with no unique features selected (Criterion 2)
